Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad
O Allah, draw me closer in it [this month] to Your pleasure
And keep me away in it from Your anger and Your punishment
And grant me success in it to recite Your verses
By Your mercy, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones
